Reviewed the complete claim, the sole ordinary implementation association (sage_ir::tcx, tcx/mod.rs), and the sole TODO test sage_meta::todo::metadata_product_boundaries. Independently verified both historical implementation and test source snapshots are exact byte matches to current files; historical rationale remains appropriate, with the following limits.

Source evidence: TcxDb separates module_children and associated_items identity enumeration from fn_signature/trait_signature/adt_signature; relevant_trait_impls returns identities separately from impl_signature headers; associated_type_value accepts one impl identity and one associated item identity and returns one value. RawAssociatedItems holds identities/name/kind, RawImplSignature holds generics/trait/predicates/completeness, and RawAssociatedTypeValue holds a value/completeness. No operation returns external function or impl bodies for checking. Thus the exposed semantic interface supports product boundaries and body exclusion. Macro expansion returns expansion text, not checked external function bodies.

Separate tracked products and consumer ordering/selectivity are not established merely by these trait declarations. The explicit TODO test preserves the missing verification matrix: method lookup, trait proof, and normalization must trace identity enumeration before selected signatures, applicable headers, and requested individual values, excluding sibling items/values, unrelated impls, and callee/impl bodies. Its prerequisite is observable consumer query traces and fixtures distinguishing selected identities from unrelated/sibling products; asserting their sequence and exclusions would detect eager bulk loading or premature detail requests. The empty TODO body supplies no behavioral assertions and does not prove tracking or consumer behavior. That gap is explicitly deferred, consistent with the prior report; no N/A entries exist. All claim aspects are accounted for as interface evidence or deferred consumer/tracking verification, not a claim of completed behavior or test adequacy.

Execution: personally ran review start, review read for the review specification, and exact-byte snapshot comparisons, followed by review record. No behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer. The coordinator separately reports 321 passing sage-meta tests and a passing root cargo build; those results do not discharge this TODO. No source edits or additional semantic dependencies were used. No requested edits to this explicit deferral accounting.
